clips.title: The story
paras: Cold drafts sweep through Chillwind Point, a rocky rise above the mountain pass. The ancient troll ruin sits where Hillsbrad Foothills, the Alterac Mountains, and the Western Plaguelands meet, and Bath'rah the Windwatcher lives among its stones.

Chillwind Point overlooks the ravine from Hillsbrad's edge. The pass leads into the Western Plaguelands, while the Alterac Mountains rise nearby. Long before Lordaeron claimed these routes, ancient trolls built stone structures on the heights. Their weather-beaten remains still face the elements. Cold winds now blow south through the ravine, carrying the chill of the fallen north into the foothills below.

Bath'rah the Windwatcher lives among the old stones at Chillwind Point. The jungle troll hermit communes with the violent gales that course through the gap. Despite the bleak exposure and the nearby Scourge-ravaged lands, his camp is not entirely deserted. Travelers and shamans heading north often seek him out to learn the secrets of the mountain currents.
